input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 applies New York law and Section 28.2 gives exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County, with mutual submission to personal jurisdiction and venue waivers — exactly the playbook's preferred position. A document-wide search returns no arbitration provision, so there is no foreign-seated arbitration concern. The pre-filing executive escalation in Section 28.3 is mutual and expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings, so it does not impair our access to the agreed courts; the carve-out in 28.2 for temporary injunctive relief elsewhere is likewise mutual. No redline required.
